newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices gain on falling arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices gain on falling arrivals.

text.p: Indian castorseed December prices rose to 1,164/1,165 rupees from 1,158/1,159 rupees on Thursday on fresh buying and lower arrivals, dealers said.
"Increased export enquiries and rising global prices also prompted fresh bull buying," one dealer said.
Daily castorseed arrivals in the Gujarat region have fallen to 4-5,000 bags (75 kg each) against 8-10,000 bags last week.
